```{ojs}
//| include: false
// A share chart (bars) for a distribution spec; compare areas draw as grouped bars.
shareChart = async (spec, {sort = false, labels, categories} = {}) => {
  const rows = await distribution(handle, spec, refs, vintage, categories);
  if (!rows.length) return unavailable();
  const order = sort ? sortByFirst(rows) : (categories ?? spec.categories).map((c) => c.label);
  return responsive((w) => bars({rows, order, seriesOrder: refs.map((r) => r.label), format: pct1, tickFormat: pct0,
                                 labels: labels ?? refs.length === 1, width: w}));
}
```

```{ojs}
//| include: false
// An ACS history chart for one indicator, with the margin of error as a band.
trendChart = async (id, {zero = false} = {}) => {
  const ind = BY_ID[id];
  const colors = chartColors();
  const data = await indicatorSeries(handle, ind, refs);
  if (!data.length) return unavailable();
  const fmt = FORMATS[ind.format];
  const series = refs.map((r, i) => ({
    label: r.label, color: colors[i],
    points: data.filter((d) => d.id === r.id).map((d) => ({x: d.vintage, y: d.value,
      lo: d.moe == null ? null : d.value - d.moe, hi: d.moe == null ? null : d.value + d.moe,
      note: `${METHODS[d.method].short} · ${d.vintage - 4}–${d.vintage} ACS`}))
  })).filter((s) => s.points.length);
  return html`${responsive((w) => lines({series, format: fmt, tickFormat: ind.format === "pct" ? pct0 : fmt, zero, width: w, xFormat: (v) => `${v - 4}–${String(v).slice(2)}`, xTicks: 5}))}
    ${note("Each point is a 5-year ACS period. Periods overlap, so compare periods that do not (for example 2014–18 and 2019–23). Shaded band: margin of error where one is published.")}`;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
glance = {
  const ids = ["pop", "households", "median_income", "median_age", "median_value"];
  const values = await Promise.all(ids.map((id) => indicatorValues(handle, BY_ID[id], refs, vintage)));
  const jobsNow = await lodesValues(handle, "wac", refs, lodesLatest);
  const period = `${vintage - 4}–${vintage} ACS`;
  const box = (ind, map) => {
    const v = map.get(selected.id);
    const fmt = FORMATS[ind.format];
    const other = compare ? map.get(compare.id) : null;
    return html`${valueBox({
      label: ind.label,
      value: v?.value == null ? "–" : fmt(v.value) + (v.flag === "+" ? "+" : ""),
      sub: v?.moe != null ? `±${fmt(v.moe)} · ${period}` : period,
      method: v?.method, methods: METHODS})}
      ${other ? html`<div class="pf-compare">${compare.label}: ${other.value == null ? "–" : fmt(other.value)}</div>` : ""}`;
  };
  const jobs = jobsNow.get(`${selected.id}|C000`);
  const jobsOther = compare ? jobsNow.get(`${compare.id}|C000`) : null;
  return html`<div class="pf-values">
    ${ids.map((id, i) => box(BY_ID[id], values[i]))}
    <div>${valueBox({label: "Jobs located here", value: fmtInt(jobs), sub: `${lodesLatest} · LEHD LODES`, method: "aggregated", methods: METHODS})}
      ${compare ? html`<div class="pf-compare">${compare.label}: ${fmtInt(jobsOther)}</div>` : ""}</div>
  </div>`;
}
```

  indicator: Inputs.select(INDICATORS.filter((i) => i.map), {format: (i) => i.label, value: BY_ID.median_income})

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const ind = mapOpts.indicator, tractLayer = mapOpts.layer === "tracts";
  const type = tractLayer ? "tract" : geo.geo_type;
  const period = tractLayer ? vintages[vintages.length - 1] : vintage;
  const [values, shapes, picked] = await Promise.all([
    indicatorValues(handle, ind, null, period, type), geojson(type), geojson(geo.geo_type)]);
  const tractNames = tractLayer ? new Map([...values.keys()].map((id) => [id, `Census tract ${id.slice(5)}`])) : names;
  await mapView.update({
    layer: mapOpts.layer,
    areas: tractLayer ? {type: "FeatureCollection", features: []} : shapes,
    tracts: tractLayer ? shapes : {type: "FeatureCollection", features: []},
    selected: {type: "FeatureCollection", features: picked.features.filter((f) => f.properties.id === geo.geo_id)},
    values: new Map([...values].map(([id, v]) => [id, v.value])),
    names: tractNames, format: FORMATS[ind.format], label: ind.label,
    onSelect: tractLayer ? null : (id) => {
      const option = geoChoices.find((g) => g.geo_id === id);
      if (option) { viewof geo.value = option; viewof geo.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true})); }
    }
  });
  return html`${mapView.el}<p class="pf-note">Outlined: ${geo.geo_name}. ${tractLayer ? "Tracts show the latest ACS period." : `Click an area to select it. ${vintage - 4}–${vintage} ACS.`} Basemap © OpenStreetMap contributors via OpenFreeMap.</p>`;
}
```

//| echo: false
{
  const colors = chartColors();
  const pep = await pepSeries(handle, refs);
  const allHavePep = refs.every((r) => pep.some((p) => p.id === r.id));
  if (allHavePep) {
    const series = refs.map((r, i) => ({label: r.label, color: colors[i],
      points: pep.filter((p) => p.id === r.id).map((p) => ({x: p.year, y: p.value, note: p.year === 2020 ? "New base: 2020 Census" : ""}))}));
    return html`${responsive((w) => lines({series, format: fmtInt, tickFormat: fmtCompact, width: w, xFormat: String, xTicks: 5}))}
      ${note("Annual population estimates, Census Bureau. The 2010s are based on the 2010 Census and the 2020s on the 2020 Census, so the series steps at 2020.")}`;
  }
  return trendChart("pop", {zero: true});
}

# Jobs and commute

## Row {height=320px}

::: {.card}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof lodesYear = Inputs.select(lodesYearList.slice().reverse(), {label: "Jobs and commute year", format: String, value: lodesLatest})
```

```{ojs}
//| include: false
flows = hasOd ? odFlows(handle, selected.type, selected.id, lodesYear) : []
```

```{ojs}
//| include: false
hasOd = ["aog", "mpo", "rpo", "fws", "county", "place"].includes(selected.type)
```

```{ojs}
//| include: false
jobsHere = lodesValues(handle, "wac", refs, lodesYear)
```

```{ojs}
//| include: false
workersHere = lodesValues(handle, "rac", refs, lodesYear)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const jobs = jobsHere.get(`${selected.id}|C000`), workers = workersHere.get(`${selected.id}|C000`);
  let both = 0, inflow = 0, outflow = 0, outside = 0;
  for (const f of flows) {
    const o = f.origin_id === selected.id, d = f.dest_id === selected.id;
    if (o && d) both += f.jobs; else if (d) { inflow += f.jobs; if (f.origin_id === "out-of-state") outside += f.jobs; } else if (o) outflow += f.jobs;
  }
  const src = `${lodesYear} · LEHD LODES`;
  const boxes = [
    valueBox({label: "Jobs located here", value: fmtInt(jobs), sub: src, method: "aggregated", methods: METHODS}),
    valueBox({label: "Workers who live here", value: fmtInt(workers), sub: src, method: "aggregated", methods: METHODS}),
    valueBox({label: "Jobs per worker", value: jobs && workers ? (jobs / workers).toFixed(2) : "–", sub: "jobs here ÷ workers living here", method: null}),
  ];
  if (hasOd) boxes.push(
    valueBox({label: "Live and work here", value: fmtInt(both), sub: src, method: "aggregated", methods: METHODS}),
    valueBox({label: "Commute in", value: fmtInt(inflow), sub: `${fmtInt(outside)} from outside Utah`, method: "aggregated", methods: METHODS}),
    valueBox({label: "Commute out", value: fmtInt(outflow), sub: "to other Utah areas", method: "aggregated", methods: METHODS}));
  return html`<div class="pf-values">${boxes}</div>`;
}
```
:::

//| echo: false
{
  if (!hasOd) return unavailable("Commute flows are published for the region, MPO, RPO, workshop areas, counties and cities.");
  const rows = await odTop(handle, selected.type, selected.id, lodesYear, "origins", 10);
  const label = (id) => id === selected.id ? "Same area" : id === "other-ut" ? "Elsewhere in Utah" : id === "out-of-state" ? "Outside Utah" : names.get(id) ?? id;
  const data = rows.map((r) => ({category: label(r.other), series: "Jobs", value: r.jobs}));
  return html`${responsive((w) => bars({rows: data, order: data.map((d) => d.category), format: fmtInt, tickFormat: fmtCompact, width: w}))}
    ${note(`People who work in ${selected.label}, by where they live, top 10 in ${lodesYear}. Areas are of the same kind as the one chosen.`)}`;
}

# Indicators

## Row {height=900px}

::: {.card title="All indicators for this area"}
```{ojs}
//| include: false
indicatorTable = {
  const results = await Promise.all(INDICATORS.map((ind) => indicatorValues(handle, ind, refs, vintage)));
  const jobsNow = await lodesValues(handle, "wac", refs, lodesLatest);
  const row = (ind, map, ref) => {
    const v = map.get(ref.id);
    return v?.value == null ? {value: "", moe: "", method: ""} :
      {value: FORMATS[ind.format](v.value), moe: v.moe == null ? "" : `±${FORMATS[ind.format](v.moe)}`, method: METHODS[v.method].label};
  };
  const rows = INDICATORS.map((ind, i) => {
    const a = row(ind, results[i], selected), b = compare ? row(ind, results[i], compare) : null;
    return {group: ind.group, indicator: ind.label, area: selected.label, value: a.value, moe: a.moe, how: a.method,
            compare_area: compare?.label ?? "", compare_value: b?.value ?? "", compare_moe: b?.moe ?? "", compare_how: b?.method ?? "",
            period: `${vintage - 4}–${vintage} ACS`};
  });
  rows.push({group: "Jobs", indicator: "Jobs located here", area: selected.label, value: fmtInt(jobsNow.get(`${selected.id}|C000`)), moe: "",
             how: "WFRC aggregate of LEHD blocks", compare_area: compare?.label ?? "", compare_value: compare ? fmtInt(jobsNow.get(`${compare.id}|C000`)) : "",
             compare_moe: "", compare_how: compare ? "WFRC aggregate of LEHD blocks" : "", period: `${lodesLatest} LODES`});
  return rows;
}
```

  const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv], {type: "text/csv"}));
  const button = html`<a class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" href="${url}" download="${slug(selected.label)}-profile.csv">Download CSV</a>`;
  const wrap = html`<div class="pf-table-scroll"></div>`;
  wrap.append(table(indicatorTable, columns));
  return html`<p>${button}</p>${wrap}${note("Margins of error are at the 90% confidence level. Medians for WFRC areas are interpolated and have no margin of error. Percentages are shares of the matching total (for example renter households as a share of households).")}`;
